components.css: .aral-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(24px,3vw,56px);color:var(--color-ink,#262820);font-family:var(--font-body,'Manrope Variable',Arial,sans-serif)}.aral-nav a,.aral-nav button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}.aral-nav a:focus-visible,.aral-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#526044);outline-offset:5px;background:var(--color-plaster,#eeeae2)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.aral-nav a:hover,.aral-nav button:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}}

components.name: Project Caption
components.description: Permanent project identity and explicit concept status.
components.css: .aral-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;min-height:76px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule,#bab5aa);color:var(--color-ink,#262820);font-family:var(--font-body,'Manrope Variable',Arial,sans-serif)}.aral-caption h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(28px,2.6vw,44px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.025em}.aral-caption p{margin:0;border-left:1px solid var(--color-rule,#bab5aa);padding-left:24px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--color-secondary,#5c5c50)}@media(max-width:767px){.aral-caption{gap:16px}.aral-caption h1{font-size:30px}.aral-caption p{padding-left:16px}}

narrative.overview: The approved Direction D world combines monumental editorial typography, warm stone, timber, olive landscape and controlled whole/detail image relationships. Phase 1 ships only the responsive hero and desktop transformation. Later homepage surfaces remain separately authorized future scope. Real ARAL-over-photo layering supplies depth; no separate foreground cutout ships.
keyCharacteristics: Warm mineral surfaces and editorial contrast
Native scroll and deliberate mobile recomposition

rules.name: The Warm Continuity Rule
rules.body: Keep future reading and contact surfaces in the same warm world; photography carries shifts in light and density.

rules.name: The One Identity Rule
rules.body: Large and compact ARAL share the same local font family and opsz 96.

dos: Do preserve coherent warm whole/detail imagery
Do preserve native scroll, keyboard access and static reduced motion
Do distinguish shipped primitives from future surfaces
donts: Don't reintroduce the obsolete foreground cutout
Don't repeat masked headings throughout the site
Don't add generic feature grids or universal reveals
Don't implement later phases without authorization
